function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time weather data. You might want to check a reliable weather website or app for the current temperature in Riga.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How hot is it now in Riga?" They want current temperature. We need to provide the answer. There's no tool for weather. We can respond with approximate or say we don't have real-time data. But we can provide a general answer: It's currently around X degrees Celsius. But we don't know. We could say "I don't have real-time data." But maybe we can approximate based on typical weather. But it's July 28, 2026. In Riga, late July, average high ~22°C. But we can't guarantee. We should respond that we don't have real-time data. So answer: I don't have real-time data.
